name: 2015 College Football Playoff
overview: The 2015 College Football Playoff was a coronation of chaos, a triumph of coaching, and a postseason that saw a team rise from early-season doubts to a dominant national champion. In just his second year at the helm, Urban Meyer led Ohio State on a miraculous run through the playoff, capping it off with a stunning 42–20 win over Oregon in the national championship. It was a postseason full of jaw-dropping performances, star-making moments, and the realization that college football’s new playoff system could deliver the unexpected.
